title: Top Dash Cams for Insurance-Proof Footage (2026)
summary: The guide highlights five dash cams that stand out for insurance‑proof footage in 2026.
method: Selections were based on the recommendations from Car & Driver, Road & Track, and DashCamTalk, prioritizing products mentioned by more than one source and noting their key features.
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

products.name: Viofo A329S
why: The Viofo A329S offers 4K front recording and a 1080p rear camera, balancing quality and cost.
It includes parking mode and a wide‑angle lens for comprehensive coverage.
products.desc: The Viofo A329S is a 4K front dash cam with a 1080p rear camera, parking mode, and wide‑angle lens.
products.benefit: Picture a commuter who wants clear footage of both front and rear traffic. The Viofo A329S delivers 4K front video and 1080p rear video, giving a full view of incidents. It beats the MioFive S1 Ultra in price and offers rear recording, which the Ultra lacks. The catch: its rear camera is only 1080p, not 4K.
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious drivers who want front and rear coverage

products.name: Garmin X310
why: The Garmin X310 offers 4K front recording, 1080p rear, GPS logging, and a built‑in LTE module for cloud storage.
It includes parking mode and a wide‑angle lens for full coverage.
products.desc: The Garmin X310 is a premium dash cam with 4K front and 1080p rear recording, GPS logging, LTE connectivity, parking mode, and a wide‑angle lens.
products.benefit: Picture a tech‑savvy driver who wants real‑time cloud uploads and GPS data. The Garmin X310 records 4K front footage, logs GPS, and uploads to the cloud via LTE, giving instant evidence. It beats the MioFive S1 Ultra by adding GPS and LTE, but it is pricier and heavier. The catch: it requires a separate LTE subscription for cloud uploads.
products.best_for: Tech‑savvy drivers needing GPS and cloud uploads

products.name: 70mai T800
why: The 70mai T800 records 4K front and 1080p rear video, includes GPS logging, and offers a 3‑channel interior camera option.
It features parking mode and a wide‑angle lens for comprehensive coverage.
products.desc: The 70mai T800 is a midrange dash cam with 4K front and 1080p rear recording, GPS logging, parking mode, and a wide‑angle lens.
products.benefit: Picture a driver who wants 4K front footage and GPS data without a premium price. The 70mai T800 records 4K front video, logs GPS, and offers parking mode, giving solid evidence for insurance claims. It outperforms the Viofo A329S by adding GPS, but it is heavier and has a less robust build. The catch: it lacks LTE connectivity for cloud uploads.
products.best_for: Drivers wanting 4K front footage and GPS without premium cost
products.skip_if: You need LTE or 3‑channel interior recording
